components.name: resizable-split-pane
components.role: Resizable two/three-pane workspace shell for dense tools
usage_guidance: primary work happens between list, canvas/chat, and detail panels
users need to compare or inspect adjacent information without navigation
avoid_when: single linear form or landing page is enough

components.name: citation-drawer
components.role: Source and citation drawer for AI answers, policies, and quoted evidence
usage_guidance: answers must show supporting policy, document, or source records
users need to inspect evidence without losing conversation context
avoid_when: citations are static footnotes only

components.name: decision-record-card
components.role: Auditable decision record summarizing decision, actor, evidence, and retention
usage_guidance: a reviewer or AI-assisted workflow reaches a durable decision
regulated teams need record ids and retention status
avoid_when: the action is transient and not auditable

components.name: policy-matrix
components.role: Policy requirement by answer/field matrix with pass, warning, and exception states
usage_guidance: multiple policy rules must be checked against multiple claims or fields
reviewers need dense scan-and-drill compliance status
avoid_when: there is only one policy outcome

components.name: source-card
components.role: Compact source record card with title, excerpt, metadata, and verification state
usage_guidance: AI output depends on external or internal source records
users need a repeatable citation preview component
avoid_when: source metadata is unavailable

components.name: audit-timeline
components.role: Chronological audit trail with actor, action, timestamp, and linked artifact
usage_guidance: regulated workflows require traceable user and AI actions
reviewers need to reconstruct what happened before approval
avoid_when: events are not user-facing or not actionable

components.name: diff-viewer
components.role: Before/after document comparison with inline additions and removals
usage_guidance: AI rewrites, policy edits, or reviewer changes need auditability
users must approve what changed before publishing
avoid_when: only a short status message changed

components.name: redline-viewer
components.role: Review-oriented prose surface with suggested insertions, deletions, and comments
usage_guidance: legal, compliance, or editorial text needs reviewer markup
comments must stay anchored to exact text ranges
avoid_when: structured rows are more important than prose

components.name: approval-rail
components.role: Persistent approval state rail with owners, blockers, and next action
usage_guidance: work requires review, approval, rejection, or handoff
users need to know who owns the next decision
avoid_when: there is no explicit workflow owner or state

components.name: risk-summary-card
components.role: Compact risk score card with drivers, confidence, and recommended mitigation
usage_guidance: users need a fast read of risk before drilling into policy details
AI confidence or compliance severity must be visible
avoid_when: score cannot be explained with drivers

components.name: inspector-drawer
components.role: Contextual detail drawer for properties, policy facts, or record metadata
usage_guidance: a selected item needs rich detail without leaving the main workflow
users need source facts, owners, versions, or retention metadata
avoid_when: the detail is short enough for an inline disclosure

components.name: reviewer-assignment-picker
components.role: Reviewer picker with role, availability, and escalation hints
usage_guidance: workflows require human approval or reassignment
reviewer choice depends on policy ownership or availability
avoid_when: there is only one fixed reviewer
